description: svc workflow hooks for Claude Code. `hooks` lists exactly what scripts/wire-hooks.mjs wires (validate-hooks-json-matches-wirer.mjs keeps them identical); `engine_children` are the deny-capable guards that run INSIDE svc-pretool-decision-engine and must never be wired separately. Profile control: SVC_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal|full (default: full). Selective disable: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=<comma-separated-ids>, including engine-child ids. The optional Stop completion guard may hard-block stop (enforce mode) when a task graph bound to the session still has actionable work.

PreToolUse.description: WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01: ONE deny-capable pre-tool decision engine per host event. Classifies observation vs mutation once against the immutable original input (typed envelope; reason codes OBSERVATION_PROVEN, AUTH_BINDING_MISSING_SELF_HEAL_INELIGIBLE, BRANCH_REF_INVALID, WORKTREE_ROOT_UNAPPROVED), normalizes Git optional-lock reads via per-argv --no-optional-locks (never an export prefix), performs exact existing-worktree self-heal behind fresh positive prompt intent, renews due controller leases as part of authorization, and writes the one-time post-tool correlation receipt. Runs every policy guard (worktree isolation, workflow/bash guard, loop guard, skill-artifact authenticity, session-contract freshness, inertia check, skill-load enforcer, impact triad) as children on the governed path only.

WI-481: early impact-triad feedback when a TaskUpdate marks a task completed. Its Bash side (commit/completion commands) runs as a child of svc-pretool-decision-engine; this entry covers only TaskUpdate, which the engine does not match.

Loop guard for the Agent tool: warns, then blocks, an identical Agent call repeated consecutively. Its Bash/Edit/Write side runs as a child of svc-pretool-decision-engine; this entry covers only Agent.

Blocks TaskUpdate(completed) when the active task's eval_matrix still has unfilled pillar entries. Structural mode (default): enforces prefix format + evidence refs. AI mode (SVC_EVAL_MODE=ai): also runs a claude -p quality check to verify evidence is substantive, not generic. Scoped to TaskUpdate only — no overhead on other tools.

HARD BLOCK for declared contracts (WI-185): PreToolUse hook for Skill invocations. If a co-located .svc/preflight-<skill>.json config exists, runs preflight checks (inputs readable, outputs writable) and blocks declared failures. Missing contracts still fail open. WI-399 A1: matcher narrowed * -> Skill — the hook is a guaranteed no-op for every other tool (its own logic exits 0 unless tool_name==Skill), so the universal matcher was a pure spawn tax on every tool call.

HARD BLOCK (WI-552 AC-552-4): PreToolUse hook for Skill invocations. If the current session id is the exact session a restart-boundary continuation baton (.svc/continuation/<WI>.ledger.jsonl) launched and is still open, denies diagnose-bug/plan-changeset/execute-changeset (or whatever the baton declares) mechanically. Sessions with no active continuation baton are unaffected. Disable: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-continuation-phase-guard.

The one context injector process per Edit/Write/Bash (WI-361 + WI-384 + WI-392): injects subject-matter rules for signal-matching paths/commands (skills-manifest.json rulesRegistry), the 1-3 learnings keyed to the touched path or command (svc-learning-inject.mjs, in-process), and intended-owner routing reminders (svc-owner-inject.mjs, in-process). Governed repos only (an existing .svc/). additionalContext only; never a permission decision. Each part stays disableable: svc-rule-injector-edit, svc-rule-injector-bash, svc-learning-inject, svc-owner-inject.

PostToolUse.description: WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01: replay-safe post-tool correlation. A successful call may heartbeat only by consuming the one-time mode-0600 pre-tool receipt bound to host/session/tool-use/original-digest/lease/generation; threshold-renews that exact authorized tuple and mirrors the v1 claim only after v2 success. Replays and mismatches are typed no-ops; failed calls extend nothing. Never grants authority.

Injects eval matrix reminder after TaskUpdate(in_progress). For diagnose-bug tasks: auto-initializes the 8-pillar matrix in lane-tasks.json if not already present, then prints the checklist so the agent sees exactly which pillars need assessment. Scoped to TaskUpdate only — zero overhead on other tools.

WI-363: auto-records phase receipts when a successful Edit/Write touches a declared phase writes-path, or a mutating Bash (>>, tee, sed -i, canonical appenders) touches one (one phase per event; judgment phases manual). One entry for both sides; svc-phase-receipt-autoemit-edit / -bash still disable a side.
WI-361: earlier-arrival rule injection while exploring (Read/Grep/Glob); same process as svc-rule-injector, rules only. Governed repos only.

HARD BLOCK: validates .svc/lane-tasks-*.json after any Edit|Write. Catches JSON syntax errors and task-graph schema violations immediately at write time. Enforces framework gap G3 from 2026-04-19 Gemini slim-refactor audit. Silent when the edited file is not a lane-tasks JSON.

HARD BLOCK: when a WI file (docs/specs/work-items/WI-*.md) is marked Status: VERIFIED via Edit|Write, verifies the Pillar Revisit Audit table contains all 8 pillars. Draft/in-progress WIs exit 0; malformed VERIFIED WIs block.

Stop.description: The generic quality gate: format + typecheck of the source files changed in the working tree (git diff vs HEAD + untracked), with checkers already installed in the project (node_modules/.bin or PATH; nothing is downloaded). An unchanged file set is not re-checked, so a quiet Stop costs one git status. Works in any git repo and writes nothing into it (cache and baseline live under ~/.cache/svc). Advisory mode: findings as a systemMessage. Enforce mode: NEW type errors since the session's first check block Stop. Full profile only.
HARD BLOCK: scans the latest assistant closeout text on Stop and blocks AP-31 verification delegation or WI-199 V0 bundle-grep substitution when no nearby V1/V2/V3 runtime evidence anchor exists.

Optional completion guard. Blocks stop when the task graph of a WI bound to THIS session (.svc/lane-tasks-<WI>.json) still has actionable work (`pending` or `in_progress`). Attribution: a worktree binding, SVC_WORKER_WI, a WI branch, the single active graph, or this session's own session-contract row. With several graphs and none attributable to the session it stays silent. `blocked` tasks are reported but do not deadlock the stop path. The singular .svc/lane-tasks.json path is legacy compatibility only.

OBSERVE: captures high-signal learning candidates into gitignored .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl at Stop (async) and before compaction. Governed repos only (an existing .svc/); never creates .svc/, never writes tracked learning files, never blocks. At Stop it also records the authorization-envelope usage summary when the session declared typed authorization rules.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Session start: if the opening prompt names a WI/project, inject origin-orchestrator bind context. Never blocks.
SOFT WARN: per-prompt scan of .svc/orchestrator-state.json for active WIs without a matching lane-tasks file. Never blocks.

SessionStart.description: SessionStart: preloads the highest-confidence framework learnings (references/framework-learnings.jsonl + unpromoted .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl). Only in the framework repo and in projects that opted in (an existing .svc/); a plain project gets nothing.

SessionStart (WI-507): company chief-of-staff briefing from company-state, cached 30 s. A stat walk first: without a company-state/ dir or .svc/company-link.json nothing is spawned and nothing is printed.
SessionStart (WI-507): up to 3 recently promoted WIs for this repo from ~/.svc/wi-promotion-index.jsonl (written by verify-promotion). Exits without spawning when the index does not exist.

SOFT WARN: on session start, resolves the active host via provision/hosts/<host>.json, scans that host's skills path for dangling symlinks and hook command paths, then self-heals with ./setup --host <host> when possible (deferred to a printed command in advisory mode). Never blocks.

SOFT (WI-393): flags prior sessions whose every assistant turn was an output-limit/API error with zero tool use, as a learning candidate in .svc/zombie-session-candidates.jsonl plus one SessionStart note. Governed repos only; incremental (a size/mtime cache under ~/.cache/svc/zombie-sweep means only new or grown transcripts are read). Never blocks.
Session start: if the opening prompt names a WI/project, inject origin-orchestrator bind context. Never blocks.

PreCompact.description: OBSERVE: captures high-signal learning candidates into gitignored .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl at Stop (async) and before compaction. Governed repos only (an existing .svc/); never creates .svc/, never writes tracked learning files, never blocks. At Stop it also records the authorization-envelope usage summary when the session declared typed authorization rules.

engine_children.description: Mutations must happen in the session's bound WI worktree, not the default checkout.

HARD BLOCK (full profile): Blocks Write/Edit to linter, formatter, type-checker, test runner configs, and lock files — agent must fix the code, not the config. HARD BLOCK: dynamic phase gate (prerequisite skills incomplete). SOFT WARNING: out-of-scope writes + planning-file edits during execution. WI-399 A1: the former svc-phase-boundary-detector entry is merged into this single spawn (one process per Edit/Write instead of two; --phase-boundary stays valid for old wirings). Disable config-protection only: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-config-protection.

HARD BLOCK (all profiles): blocks --no-verify / --no-gpg-sign git bypass. HARD BLOCK (full profile): blocks git commit missing Co-Authored-By trailer. SOFT WARN (full profile): warns on vague commit messages. Disable individually: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-block-no-verify or svc-commit-quality.
Warns, then blocks, an identical tool call repeated consecutively.

HARD BLOCK (G-4 / WI-114): blocks Edit/Write to canonical skill-output paths (docs/specs/features/, design-tech/, plans/, decisions/, capability-plan.md, etc.) when no recent invocation of the responsible skill exists in .svc/pipeline-decisions.jsonl. Recency window: SVC_SKILL_RECEIPT_WINDOW_MIN (default 90 min). Bypass: SVC_SKILL_ARTIFACT_ALLOW=1.
HARD BLOCK: blocks direct file tools and concrete Bash mutation targets when the session contract (.svc/session-contract.jsonl) is stale or mismatched. Read-only Bash remains on the fast path.
HARD BLOCK: blocks Edit/Write content that adds APIs or framework patterns listed in references/deprecated-foundations.json unless SVC_INERTIA_ACK records an explicit migrate-vs-extend decision.
A governed mutation requires the bound task's skill-load receipt.

steps: 1. Ensure Node.js and Bash are available in your PATH.

2. Install with the setup script from the framework checkout: ./setup --host claude (or ./setup --all-hosts). It symlinks the framework and runs scripts/wire-hooks.mjs, which rebuilds every svc-managed entry in ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently and keeps your own hooks byte-for-byte.
3. To re-wire without a full install (e.g. after settings.json was reset): node scripts/wire-hooks.mjs --skills-path ~/.claude/skills. Use --dry-run to preview and --list-all to print every entry.

4. Do not copy entries from this file into settings.json by hand. Copied entries are not recognized as managed, so a later setup adds its own copy and both run. In particular, never wire an engine_children entry (svc-workflow-guard, svc-bash-guard, svc-loop-guard, svc-skill-artifact-authenticity, svc-session-contract-freshness, svc-inertia-check, ...) on its own: svc-pretool-decision-engine already runs it once per tool call, so a separate entry runs it twice and can re-classify a call the engine already decided.

5. The optional completion guard (Stop) is part of the managed set: bash hooks/svc-task-completion-guard.sh, read from stdin, wired by setup (through the durable launcher when it is installed). Disable it with SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-task-completion-guard.
6. Hook mode: advisory by default (findings are reported, nothing blocks); set {"mode":"enforce"} in ~/.svc/hook-policy.json to make guards blocking. See docs/hook-modes.md.
7. To enable AI quality checks for the eval gate (claude -p judge): set SVC_EVAL_MODE=ai. Requires the claude CLI on PATH.
8. Profile control: export SVC_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal (fewer hooks) or full (default); export SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=<ids> to disable individual hooks, then re-run setup.
